australian_crosspollination.provenance_boundary: A source origin (e.g. senator's disclosure) is distinct from ABC's copy, a related owner's source-written Bool, a court judgment reprint, an AEC future disclosure and actual external-world correctness.
australian_crosspollination.statutory_time_boundary: Federal July 2025-June 2026 financial-year donation scheme and Jan 2027 calendar-year reform are separate regimes; February 2027 future publication cannot be retroactively claimed inspected October 2026.
australian_crosspollination.original_policy_transmission_ceiling: One Nation's 2025 official publication is a policy producer original; Hanson's 2026 first-person attribution is a different later statement. Neither is a dated original Rinehart instruction or independent proof of downstream legislative adoption.
